title: Ramonyx application config (input)
description: Bentuk input `ramonyx.config.ts` (RamonyxConfigInput). Default dari resolveConfig: app.strictValidation=true, server.port=3000, server.host="localhost". Diverifikasi test tests/docs/config-schema.test.ts terhadap packages/core/src/config.ts.

strictValidation.description: Default true. Validasi schema runtime di trust boundary.

streaming.description: Default false. SSR streaming (ADR-0047) — dibaca CLI dev/start.
